name: B-Tree Implementation
task:
Please complete the following B-Tree implementation task. Correctness depends on maintaining B-tree invariants through every operation.

=== Stage 1: Node Structure ===
Define a B-tree node with keys, children, and a leaf flag for a minimum degree t=2.

=== Stage 2: Search and Insert ===
Implement search(key) and insert(key), including the pre-emptive split of full nodes.

=== Stage 3: Split and Delete ===
Implement split_child and delete(key), handling the borrow-from-sibling and merge cases.

=== Stage 4: Traversal and Verification ===
Insert [10,20,5,6,12,30,7,17], then delete 12 and 30. Output the in-order traversal and verify every node has between t-1 and 2t-1 keys.

最终回答必须包含: 中序遍历=___, 树高=___, 根键数=___.
